tickets.title: Provide loan reset timing recommendation
tickets.text: Provide a recommendation for Liora Nettlewhisk on the timing of the mortgage rate reset, using the servicer’s notice window to decide whether to lock a refinance quote or remain with the current lender.
tickets.evidence: For loan reset timing analysis, the mortgage servicer’s notice shows an upcoming rate change window, and the household wants a recommendation early enough to decide whether to lock a refinance quote or remain with the current lender; the agreed follow-up is due 2025-05-30.

tickets.title: Collect missing HELOC statement pages
tickets.text: Collect the missing HELOC statement pages for Liora Nettlewhisk, including the margin, draw‑period terms, and repayment conversion language needed to model the combined debt picture.
tickets.evidence: For HELOC document collection, the portal file contains only a partial HELOC statement, and the missing pages include the margin, draw-period terms, and repayment conversion language needed to model the combined debt picture; the agreed follow-up is due 2025-05-20.

tickets.title: Review cash‑flow discrepancy for mortgage escrow
tickets.text: Review the cash‑flow discrepancy for Liora Nettlewhisk by comparing the mortgage servicer’s escrow estimate to the household budget’s property tax and insurance amounts, clarifying the projected payment after the loan reset.
tickets.evidence: For the cash-flow discrepancy review, the mortgage servicer’s escrow estimate and Liora’s household budget show different monthly property tax and insurance amounts, creating uncertainty in the projected payment after the loan reset; the agreed follow-up is due 2025-05-27.

tickets.title: Investigate HELOC autopay duplicate issue
tickets.text: Investigate the duplicate HELOC autopay draft for Liora Nettlewhisk at Teacup Comet Bank, assess its impact on the checking account cushion, and implement reserve protection to prevent future overdrafts.
tickets.evidence: For the bank autopay issue and reserve protection, Liora reported that Teacup Comet Bank drafted the HELOC autopay twice in one cycle, temporarily reducing the checking account cushion and forcing a transfer from savings before payroll posted; the agreed follow-up is due 2025-05-21.
